name: launch-video
title: Launch Video
description: Product launch video template: a title, a highlighted claim, your app on a phone, a follower count and a wordmark outro — five snapcn components composed into one 21-second Remotion video, in one install.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/launch-video?ref=cli — change the copy props (headline, highlight, screenSrc, followerCount, wordmark) and register <LaunchVideo /> as a 1280x720, 30fps composition LAUNCH_VIDEO_DURATION frames long. Each beat was installed as its own component too, so any one of them can be swapped for another snapcn component. — 48 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/pro?ref=cli-docs
